mapper.select: SELECT log.id, log.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS actorName, log.action, log.from_status AS fromStatus, log.to_status AS toStatus, log.comment, log.created_at AS createdAt, u.avatar AS actorAvatar, u.updated_at AS actorUpdatedAt, NULL AS actorAvatarUrl FROM workflow_action_log log JOIN app_user u ON u.id = log.actor_user_id WHERE log.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND log.instance_id = #{instanceId} ORDER BY log.created_at, log.id

SELECT log.id, log.actor_user_id AS actorUserId, COALESCE(NULLIF(u.display_name, ''), u.username) AS actorName, log.action, log.from_status AS fromStatus, log.to_status AS toStatus, log.comment, log.created_at AS createdAt, u.avatar AS actorAvatar, u.updated_at AS actorUpdatedAt, NULL AS actorAvatarUrl FROM workflow_action_log log JOIN workflow_instance instance ON instance.id = log.instance_id AND instance.tenant_id = log.tenant_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id = log.actor_user_id WHERE log.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND instance.business_type = #{businessType} AND instance.business_id = #{businessId} ORDER BY log.created_at, log.id
